parameters.command:
=# 1. Ensure tmux session exists
tmux has-session -t n8n-{{ $json.session_id }} 2>/dev/null || \
tmux new-session -d -s n8n-{{ $json.session_id }}

# 2. Marker & output files
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%s)
MARKER_FILE="/tmp/n8n-{{ $json.session_id }}-${TIMESTAMP}.done"
OUTPUT_FILE="/tmp/n8n-{{ $json.session_id }}-${TIMESTAMP}.out"
SCRIPT_FILE="/tmp/n8n-{{ $json.session_id }}-${TIMESTAMP}.sh"
rm -f "$MARKER_FILE" "$OUTPUT_FILE" "$SCRIPT_FILE"

# 3. Write the command to a script file
cat > "$SCRIPT_FILE" << 'EOFSCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
MARKER_FILE="MARKER_PLACEHOLDER"
OUTPUT_FILE="OUTPUT_PLACEHOLDER"
URL="URL_PLACEHOLDER"

echo "Validating $URL"

(http_status=$(curl -o /dev/null -s -w '%{http_code}' "$URL"); \
if [ "$http_status" -ne 200 ]; then \
  echo "HTTP check failed with status $http_status" >&2; \
fi; \
echo "HTTP check succeeded"; \
touch "$MARKER_FILE") 2>&1 | tee "$OUTPUT_FILE"
EOFSCRIPT

# 4. Replace placeholders
sed -i "s|MARKER_PLACEHOLDER|$MARKER_FILE|g" "$SCRIPT_FILE"
sed -i "s|OUTPUT_PLACEHOLDER|$OUTPUT_FILE|g" "$SCRIPT_FILE"
sed -i "s|URL_PLACEHOLDER|{{ $json.url }}|g" "$SCRIPT_FILE"

chmod +x "$SCRIPT_FILE"

# 5. Execute the script in tmux
tmux send-keys -t n8n-{{ $json.session_id }}:0 "$SCRIPT_FILE" C-m

# 6. Wait for marker file
while [ ! -f "$MARKER_FILE" ]; do
    sleep 0.5
done

# 7. Output cleaned version
sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' "$OUTPUT_FILE" | \
sed 's/\r/\n/g' | \
grep -v '━' | \
grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' | \
uniq

# 8. Clean up
rm -f "$MARKER_FILE" "$OUTPUT_FILE" "$SCRIPT_FILE"
